elements.label: Figure 4.5
elements.title: Countries should set standards along their development trajectories in relation to international trade
elements.content:
Line chart showing Quality/performance on the y-axis against Development trajectory on the x-axis, with three main stages: Adapt (A), Align (B), and Author.

- Y-axis levels from bottom to top:
  - Domestic standards
  - International standards
  - Technical regulations in export destination
  - Buyers' private standards

- Stages:
  - Adapt (A): Adapt international standards for the domestic market. Shows a compliance costs arrow pointing upwards from domestic standards to technical regulations/buyers' private standards. The curve starts at Domestic standards and rises toward international standards.
  - Align (B): Align domestic market with international standards. Shows compliance costs. The curve levels off along international standards.
  - Author: Shape international standards with the global community. Shows an arrow labeled 'Drive global knowledge' rising sharply toward higher quality/performance.

Source: WDR 2025 team.
